title: Atlas Edit Proposal — 2026-11-16
body:
## Summary

This proposal includes the following edits:

- **Add Halo Agents And Sky Core Halos** - Defines Halo Agents and adds Sky Core Halos, starting with Test Halo, which is used to test new Agent architecture in production.
- **Align The Distribution Reward And Integration Boost Invocation Processes** - Creates Invocation entries only after Operational GovOps confirms feasibility, and aligns the status and removal steps for rejected or failed proposals across both Primitives.
- **Specify The hop And maxChange Bounds For The Osero Diamond PAU On Base** - Sets the hop to 16 hours and maxChange to 1.20, matching the Base defaults.
- **Update The ERC-4626 Facet's Highest Production Deposit Rate Limit** - Records 12,441,600 USDC and 2,329,067 USDC per day as the highest deposit rate limit operated in production.
- **Add File Links To The Operational Reference Materials** - Adds links to the Technical Scope Template, the Deployment Checklist and the Morpho Deployment Verification Guide.
author: adamgfraser
